decisions.reason: As a product only briefly mentioned at launch and less clearly embedded in a focused product family, the construction site dumper looks like a peripheral offer that a German machinery firm would likely discontinue if sales and service volume stayed limited.
The inclined furniture lift appears to fit a coherent lifting-and-handling niche and, as a dedicated product-page offer, is likely worth keeping unless demand has proved clearly too small.

The inclined building material lift sits close to the firm’s likely core in practical site-handling equipment and should be retained if it shares components, service, and customers with the other inclined lifts.

The truck-mounted inclined furniture lift is the most specialized and capital-intensive variant, so a cautious German machinery manufacturer would be relatively more likely to withdraw it if utilization and order intake did not justify the complexity.
